simple.prompt: ___ does the quarterly shareholder conference begin?
simple.explanation: Untuk menanyakan waktu jam spesifik, gunakan question word 'What time' atau 'When'.

simple.prompt: ___ is in charge of reviewing customer refund requests this week?
simple.explanation: 'Who' digunakan untuk menanyakan subjek orang pelaku aksi ('siapa yang bertanggung jawab').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Yes/No sederhana dengan auxiliary verb 'Do'.
simple.targetSentence: Do you prefer tea or coffee?
simple.explanation: Rumus: Do + Subject (you) + Base verb (prefer) + Object (tea or coffee)?

simple.prompt: ___ is the nearest subway station located?
simple.explanation: 'Where' digunakan untuk menanyakan lokasi atau tempat fisik.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya dengan kata tanya 'Why'.
simple.targetSentence: Why is the office closed today?
simple.explanation: Wh-word (Why) + to be (is) + Subject (the office) + Adjective (closed) + Time (today)?
hints: Inversikan to be 'is' sebelum subjek 'the office'.

simple.prompt: ___ of these two software licenses did your team purchase?
simple.explanation: Gunakan 'Which' ketika memilih dari sekumpulan opsi pilihan yang terbatas/spesifik ('these two licenses').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya untuk menanyakan durasi waktu dengan 'How long'.
simple.targetSentence: How long does the training session last?
simple.explanation: Question phrase (How long) + Auxiliary (does) + Subject (the training session) + Base verb (last)?

simple.prompt: ___ is the next train to Bandung departing?
simple.explanation: Untuk menanyakan waktu keberangkatan, gunakan kata tanya 'When'.

simple.prompt: ___ many laptops do we need to reserve for the coding bootcamp?
simple.explanation: Untuk menanyakan jumlah benda terhitung, pasangkan 'How' + 'many' ('How many laptops...?').

simple.prompt: ___ sits in the corner office beside the elevator?
simple.explanation: Untuk menanyakan siapa pelaku (Subject) yang duduk di sana, gunakan 'Who'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan resepsionis mengenai lokasi ruang rapat.
dialogue: It is on the third floor, right across from the lounge.
simple.explanation: Jawabannya menjelaskan lokasi ('on the third floor'), sehingga pertanyaannya memakai 'Where'.
hints: Lihat jawaban yang menyebut lokasi lantai 3.

simple.prompt: ___ coffee or tea do you prefer during morning meetings?
simple.explanation: Saat pilihan sudah dibatasi jelas (kopi atau teh), gunakan 'Which'.
hints: Ada dua pilihan spesifik yang ditawarkan.

simple.prompt: ___ does your team hold its weekly retrospective?
simple.explanation: Dengan auxiliary 'does' dan main verb 'hold', kata tanya yang logis di depan adalah 'When'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan urutan kata pada kalimat tanya sederhana berikut.
simple.draft: Why you are smiling so happily today?
options: Why are you smiling so happily today?
Why do you smiling so happily today?
Why you smiling so happily today?
simple.explanation: Pada pertanyaan dengan to be, to be ('are') wajib berpindah ke posisi sebelum subjek ('you'): 'Why are you smiling...?'.
hints: Ingat aturan inversi pertanyaan: Question word + Aux/Be + Subject.

simple.prompt: ___ much does the annual maintenance plan cost per seat?
simple.explanation: Untuk menanyakan harga atau jumlah tak terhitung, gunakan 'How much'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya sederhana dengan kata tanya 'Where'.
simple.targetSentence: Where did you park the company delivery van?
simple.explanation: Wh-word (Where) + did + Subject (you) + base verb (park) + object?

simple.prompt: Susun pertanyaan Yes/No untuk menanyakan kepemilikan.
simple.targetSentence: Does this clinic accept electronic insurance cards?
simple.explanation: Yes/No question Present Simple untuk subjek tunggal 'this clinic' dimulai dengan 'Does'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog dengan pertanyaan klarifikasi alasan yang tepat.
dialogue: ___ did you decide to reschedule the product launch?
Because our beta testers discovered critical bugs yesterday.
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban yang diawali 'Because' (karena) menjawab pertanyaan alasan 'Why'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ often does the internal audit committee inspect inventory logs?
intermediate.explanation: 'How often' adalah frasa tanya untuk menanyakan frekuensi pengulangan (seberapa sering).

intermediate.prompt: Notice the difference: '___ happened at the executive meeting?' (Subject question).
intermediate.explanation: Ketika kata tanya 'What/Who' berfungsi sebagai SUBJEK kalimat, TIDAK menggunakan auxiliary 'did/do/does', melainkan langsung diikuti kata kerja: 'What happened?', bukan 'What did happen?'.
hints: Pertanyaan ini menanyakan subjek pelaku peristiwa.

intermediate.prompt: Susun subject question tanpa auxiliary verb.
intermediate.explanation: Subject question: 'Who' bertindak sebagai subjek, langsung diikuti past verb 'wrote' dan objek.

intermediate.prompt: Sebaliknya, pada Object question: 'Who ___ at the networking dinner yesterday?'
intermediate.explanation: Ketika subjeknya adalah 'you' dan 'Who' adalah objek yang ditemui (Object question), wajib menggunakan auxiliary inversi: 'did you meet'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun pertanyaan dengan preposisi di akhir (preposition stranding).
intermediate.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris lisan alami, preposisi diletakkan di akhir: Who + are + you + waiting for?

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog tanya jawab tentang biaya.
dialogue: ___ does the annual software subscription cost?
It costs twelve hundred dollars per user.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk menanyakan harga atau biaya (jumlah uang), gunakan frasa 'How much'.

intermediate.prompt: Compare carefully: 'Who ___ the quarterly summary yesterday?' (asking about the author)
intermediate.explanation: Ini adalah Subject Question ('Who' bertindak sebagai pelaku); pada kalimat tanya positif subjek, JANGAN menambahkan 'did', langsung gunakan V2 'wrote'.
hints: Apakah kita sudah tahu siapa pelakunya? Tidak, 'Who' adalah subjeknya.
Subject question langsung memakai kata kerja (tanpa do/does/did).

intermediate.prompt: Now contrast with an Object Question: 'Who ___ at the international airport?'
intermediate.explanation: Di sini subjeknya sudah jelas ('you') dan kita menanyakan objek ('bertemu siapa?'), sehingga wajib memakai auxiliary 'did': 'Who did you meet...?'.
hints: Subjeknya 'you', jadi ini menanyakan objek pertemuan.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang pilihan durasi perjalanan.
dialogue: ___ does it take to reach the harbor by ferry?
Usually around forty-five minutes in calm weather.
intermediate.explanation: Jawabannya menyebut durasi waktu ('forty-five minutes'), sehingga kata tanyanya adalah 'How long'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ backpack was left near the security scanner?
intermediate.explanation: Untuk menanyakan pemilik suatu benda ('tas ransel milik siapa?'), gunakan 'Whose' sebelum kata benda.

intermediate.prompt: Which question ends naturally with a preposition in everyday English?
options: What topic are you working on?
On what topic working are you?
What topic you are working on?
intermediate.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris percakapan standar, preposisi ('on') diletakkan di akhir kalimat tanya dengan urutan normal Aux + Subject + Verb.
hints: Pastikan urutan 'are you working' tetap terbalik untuk kalimat tanya.

intermediate.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda pada kalimat tanya dengan 'What happened' berikut.
intermediate.draft: What did happen during the afternoon server maintenance?
options: What happened during the afternoon server maintenance?
What was happen during the afternoon server maintenance?
What happening during the afternoon server maintenance?
intermediate.explanation: 'What' di sini bertindak sebagai subjek pelaku kejadian, sehingga dalam Subject Question positif tidak perlu auxiliary 'did': 'What happened...?'.
hints: Tidak ada subjek lain sebelum kata 'happen'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ far is the convention center from the central railway station?
intermediate.explanation: Menanyakan jarak selalu memakai kombinasi kata tanya 'How far'.
hints: Jawaban yang diharapkan berupa jarak tempuh (km/mil).

intermediate.prompt: What ___ your colleagues say when you proposed the flexible Friday policy?
intermediate.explanation: Terdapat main verb lampau dasar 'say', sehingga auxiliary pertanyaannya adalah 'did'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Subject Question tanpa 'do/does/did'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Which team won the regional innovation award?
intermediate.explanation: 'Which team' adalah subjek yang ditanyakan, jadi langsung diikuti V2 'won' tanpa 'did'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun pertanyaan dengan preposisi di akhir kalimat.
intermediate.targetSentence: Who are you waiting for outside the main lobby?
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan kasual menempatkan 'for' di akhir setelah 'Who are you waiting'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Who are you waiting for'.
Tambahkan keterangan tempat 'outside the main lobby?'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum penataan kalimat tanya tidak langsung (indirect / embedded question).
complex.draft: Could you please tell me where is the conference hall?
options: Could you please tell me where the conference hall is?
Could you please tell me where does the conference hall locate?
Could you please tell me where is the conference hall located?
complex.explanation: Pada indirect question (kalimat tanya yang disematkan setelah 'Could you tell me...'), urutan kata KEMBALI ke urutan pernyataan normal (Subject + Verb: 'where the conference hall is'), BUKAN bentuk tanya inversi ('where is...').
hints: Indirect question tidak menggunakan inversi Verb-Subject.
Urutannya: Wh-word + Subject (the conference hall) + Verb (is).

complex.prompt: I wonder why ___ to sign the nondisclosure agreement.
complex.explanation: Setelah klausa pernyataan 'I wonder why...', klausa bawahan menggunakan urutan subjek + kata kerja biasa: 'they refused'.
Embedded question setelah 'Do you know...': susunan harus 'Subject + Verb', tanpa auxiliary 'does'.

complex.prompt: Susun indirect question yang santun dan formal.
complex.targetSentence: Do you know how much this will cost?
complex.explanation: Do you know + question phrase (how much) + Subject (this) + Verb (will cost)?
hints: Urutan klausa: how much this will cost.

complex.prompt: Koreksi pertanyaan formal dengan preposisi depan (fronted preposition).
complex.draft: To whom did you submitted the revised specifications?
options: To whom did you submit the revised specifications?
To who did you submit the revised specifications?
To whom submitted you the revised specifications?
complex.explanation: Setelah auxiliary 'did', kata kerja wajib kembali ke bentuk dasar 'submit', bukan 'submitted'. Dalam gaya formal, preposisi di depan memakai objek pronoun 'whom' ('To whom').
hints: Setelah auxiliary 'did', verb kembali ke bentuk dasar 'submit'.

complex.prompt: Negative questions often express surprise or confirmation: '___ received the tracking confirmation yet?'
complex.explanation: Negative question 'Haven't you received...?' digunakan untuk menyatakan keheranan atau meminta konfirmasi atas ekspektasi pembicara.
hints: Pertanyaan negatif untuk menyatakan rasa heran.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi dengan indirect question tingkat lanjut.
dialogue: Certainly. The cost covers 24/7 dedicated enterprise support.
options: what does this service fee include
complex.explanation: Setelah 'Can you explain...', klausa berbentuk indirect: Wh-word (what) + Subject (this service fee) + Verb (includes).

complex.prompt: Pilih struktur Indirect Question yang tepat dan santun untuk email resmi.
options: Could you please let me know when the revised draft will be ready?
Could you please let me know when will the revised draft be ready?
Could you please let me know when does the revised draft be ready?
complex.explanation: Setelah ungkapan pembuka seperti 'Could you let me know...', bagian berikutnya kembali ke urutan pernyataan (Subject + Verb: 'when the revised draft will be ready'), BUKAN inversi tanya.
hints: Sudah ada 'Could you...' sebagai penanda tanya di depan.
Klausa kedua tidak boleh dibalik lagi (pakai S + V).

complex.prompt: I would appreciate it if you could clarify why ___ signed before the audit closed.
complex.explanation: Di dalam embedded/indirect question ('clarify why...'), urutannya tetap Subject ('the agreement') sebelum Verb ('wasn't').
hints: Bentuknya klausa tidak langsung setelah 'clarify why'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum urutan kata pada indirect question berikut.
complex.draft: Do you happen to know what time does the boarding gate close?
options: Do you happen to know what time the boarding gate closes?
Do you happen to know what time close the boarding gate?
Do you happen to know when does the boarding gate closes?
complex.explanation: Dalam indirect question ('Do you happen to know...?'), hilangkan 'does' dan kembalikan verb ke bentuk pernyataan tunggal: 'what time the boarding gate closes'.
hints: Sesuaikan kata kerja 'close' dengan subjek tunggal 'gate' (-> closes).

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog formal mengenai pertanyaan dengan preposisi depan (fronted preposition).
dialogue: To the regional operations directors across all five branches.
complex.explanation: Saat preposisi diletakkan di depan kata tanya dalam bahasa formal, pronoun setelah preposisi wajib berbentuk objek 'whom': 'To whom...'.
hints: Preposisi berada di awal sebelum kata tanya orang.

complex.prompt: Notice how negative questions imply surprise or expect confirmation: '___ we already approve that vendor last Tuesday?'
complex.explanation: Pertanyaan negatif lampau dengan main verb 'approve' diawali 'Didn't' untuk meminta konfirmasi terkejut ('Bukankah kita sudah menyetujuinya?').
hints: Ada main verb aksi 'approve' dan makna keheranan/konfirmasi.

complex.prompt: Which question contains an accurate tag-like reply question showing genuine interest?
options: Our flight got rescheduled to midnight. — Did it? How inconvenient!
Our flight got rescheduled to midnight. — Got it? How inconvenient!
Our flight got rescheduled to midnight. — Was it? How inconvenient!
complex.explanation: Reply question mengulang auxiliary dari kalimat berita; 'got rescheduled' (Past Simple) memakai auxiliary 'Did it?'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggabungan pertanyaan dengan sisipan opini ('do you think') berikut.
complex.draft: Who do you think did win the architectural design competition?
options: Who do you think won the architectural design competition?
Who do you think does win the architectural design competition?
Do you think who won the architectural design competition?
complex.explanation: Pada pertanyaan subjek yang disisipi frasa opini ('do you think'), tetap ikuti aturan Subject Question tanpa 'did': 'Who do you think won...?'.
hints: Sisipan 'do you think' tetap mempertahankan pertanyaan subjek 'Who ... won'.

complex.prompt: In formal writing, choose the correct fronted-preposition version of 'Which supplier did you order the parts from?':
options: From which supplier did you order the parts?
From whom supplier did you order the parts?
From what supplier you ordered the parts?
complex.explanation: Preposisi 'from' dipindahkan ke depan 'which supplier', sementara bagian tanya utama tetap menjaga inversi 'did you order'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat Indirect Question sopan dengan pembuka 'I wonder'.
complex.targetSentence: I wonder whether the committee has reviewed our budget revision.
complex.explanation: Pola 'I wonder whether + Subject + Verb' tidak memakai tanda tanya maupun inversi.
hints: Awali dengan 'I wonder whether the committee'.
Gunakan susunan pernyataan 'has reviewed our budget revision'.

complex.prompt: Susun pertanyaan formal dengan preposisi di awal untuk menanyakan dasar argumen.
complex.targetSentence: On what evidence did the panel base its final ruling?
complex.explanation: Preposisi 'On' di depan frasa benda 'what evidence' diikuti inversi 'did the panel base'.
hints: Lanjutkan susunan tanya 'did the panel base its final ruling?'.
